goal.vi: Hỏi về căn hộ, tiền cọc, hợp đồng thuê và báo hỏng hóc cho chủ nhà.
goal.en: Ask about an apartment, the deposit and the contract, and report a problem to the owner.

lines: Hi, I'm calling about the apartment on Oak Street. Is it still available?
Yes, it is. It's 1,200 a month.
Are utilities included in the rent?
Water is included, but not electricity.
I see. How much is the security deposit? And how long is the lease?
The deposit is one month's rent, and the lease is for one year.
Great. Also, if there's ever something wrong with the heating, could someone come and take a look quickly?
Of course. Just text me and I'll send someone.

mean.vi: Hỏi căn hộ còn cho thuê không
mean.en: Ask if the apartment is still for rent

why.vi: "Available" là từ thông dụng; "free" có thể hiểu là miễn phí.
why.en: "Available" is the normal word; "free" can mean no cost.

phrases.say: Are utilities included in the rent?

mean.vi: Hỏi tiền thuê đã gồm điện nước chưa
mean.en: Ask if the rent covers water and power

why.vi: Hỏi tiền thuê gồm những gì trước khi ký.
why.en: Ask what the rent covers before you sign.

phrases.say: How much is the security deposit?
phrases.not: How much money I give before?

mean.en: Ask about the money you pay first

why.vi: "Deposit" là tiền bạn được trả lại khi chuyển đi.
why.en: The "deposit" is money you get back when you leave.

phrases.not: How long is the contract of house?

mean.vi: Hỏi thời hạn hợp đồng thuê
mean.en: Ask how long the home contract is

why.vi: Ở Mỹ, hợp đồng thuê nhà gọi là "lease".
why.en: In the US, the contract for renting a home is a "lease".

phrases.say: There's something wrong with the heating.

mean.vi: Báo cho chủ nhà một thứ bị hỏng
mean.en: Tell the owner something is broken

why.vi: "Something's wrong with…" báo sự cố một cách bình tĩnh.
why.en: "Something's wrong with…" reports a problem calmly.

phrases.say: Could someone come and take a look this week?

mean.vi: Nhờ người đến kiểm tra và sửa
mean.en: Ask for someone to come and check

why.vi: Nhờ đến sửa một cách lịch sự và nêu thời gian.
why.en: Ask for a visit politely and give a time.

phrases.say: I'm planning to move out at the end of June.
phrases.not: I will out of the house June end.

mean.vi: Báo trước ngày bạn chuyển đi
mean.en: Say when you will leave the apartment

why.vi: "Move in" và "move out" là cách nói thông dụng.
why.en: "Move in" and "move out" are the normal phrases.

ai.name: Mr. Brooks
ai.role: a landlord with an apartment for rent
ai.goal: find a good person to rent the apartment

roleplay.you: Call about an apartment: check it's still available, ask what the rent covers, ask about the deposit and how long the contract is.

turns.h: Hi, I'm calling about the apartment on Oak Street. Is it still available?
Are utilities included in the rent?
br: Water is included, but not electricity.

turns.h: How much is the security deposit? And how long is the lease?
br: One month's rent, and the lease is for one year.

turns.a: Would you like to see it?
turns.h: Yes, please. Could I come and take a look this week?
br: Sure. How about Saturday at ten?

roleplay.end: Great, see you Saturday. Bring a photo ID, please.
